findings.issue: Initial observation finiteness was not explicitly checked, and equal_nan=True could admit identical NaN values at frame0 in every comparison path.
findings.resolution: Every trace array in all three paths is required finite, including frame0; assert_allclose uses equal_nan=False. A matching-NaN initial-observation regression rejects this case before numerical comparisons.

limitations: Approval is limited to the already adopted single excluded calibration and fixed resource budget, not any long primary child campaign.
No actual P256 propagation was executed by this reviewer. The physical calibration must still pass before it is used as evidence.
A hard CPU kill can prevent the final failure receipt; the permanent attempt marker and any committed state remain, and missing/failed completion is ineligible.
The recorded short energy variation is descriptive only; this 4 fs calibration cannot demonstrate transmission, rate, plateau, timestep convergence or bead convergence.

verified_contracts: The selected first saved parent of seed 825601 (history-replay route, endpoint index 0 / sweep 2100) is fixed by whole checkpoint SHA, integrity envelope, settings fingerprint and exact q-array bytes. No parent or channel is selected from results.

One separate fixed SeedSequence [20261101,256,902731] draws bead Maxwell momenta with variance MASS*256/BETA. All six paths use copied same initial canonical q,p; no COM projection or primary RNG namespace is used.

Both 0.1 fs and 0.05 fs paths run 4 fs with 1 fs observations. Fused native continuous, public Python step loop and native 2 fs/checkpoint/destroy/recreate/reload/2 fs paths total 360 physical steps: 240 fused native and 120 manual Python, no fallback.

The unchanged Dynamics default is cayley-bcb with required native free-ring map, real masses, no constraints/bias/thermostat. Python-loop comparison shares the native free map and the real BKMP2 PES; it is not an independent all-NumPy implementation or force-field validation.

Native restart compares every recorded q,p,surface,full-ring energy,step/time array bitwise, including signed-zero distinctions. Public Python/native comparisons use the fixed inherited tolerances, exact integer steps and finite full traces.

The midpoint checkpoint includes all earlier observations and state clock, with kind/integrity/fingerprint checks. The old Dynamics and PES wrapper weak references must be dead before a replacement segment is created.
A persistent output directory/RUN_ONCE marker forbids automatic retries and overwrites. Initial state and ledger precede the first PES evaluation; failed committed outputs remain.

Whole-process RLIMIT_CPU 60 s, CPU 6 affinity and one-thread variables are installed before scientific imports; admission stops at 55 CPU / 115 wall seconds and the whole-process wall alarm is 120 s. No numerical subprocess is spawned.
Registered source/native/PES/build/parent/prior-gate identities and actual imported paths are checked; the whole guard set is rechecked before eligibility publication.
